Section.Label: sec:IteratingOverTheSmallGroupsLibrary
Section.Heading: Iterating over the Small Groups Library

ManSection.Returns: an iterator which iterates over the groups stored in &GAP;'s Small Groups Library, sorted by ascending order, starting at order start if specified, up to order finish if specified.

Section.Label: sec:IteratingOverTheTransitiveGroupsLibrary

ManSection.Returns: an iterator which iterates over the groups stored in &GAP;'s Transitive Groups Library, sorted by ascending degree, starting at degree start if specified, up to degree finish if specified.
